scenarios.name: controlled-player-plays-the-chosen-card-with-their-own-lands
scenarios.why: Oracle: look at target opponent's hand and choose a card; you control that player until the spell finishes resolving; the player plays that card if able, and may activate only mana abilities of lands they control. p0 casts Word of Command on p1, choosing Grizzly Bears from p1's hand; p1, controlled by p0, casts it paying {1}{G}: p1 is given priority and taps their own two Forests for mana. Grizzly Bears ends on the battlefield under p1's control and both of p1's Forests are tapped.
